author: NZCountryGrrl

title: The rings
body:
I think that in general that fitness app is very good, but there is just one thing that I find disappointing and it is the fact that in order to reach the goal of the stand ring you need to stand for one minute within an hour, that sounds like a joke, even Sid the sloth could do it. I hope that Apple can change this, and set some more realistic goal, a real goal. At least 30 minutes.
This is a new review, and by the way, I never got an answer from my first one, hopefully you will reply to this one. The app worked fine for a long time, but lately, maybe one or two months ago, it started to fail, in the sense that the rings keep changing my goals, and even though if I check the goals they are fine inside, but in the screen, they look different, let’s say I have 16 hours for the stand goal, but the app changes to 15, or 14, and the other two rings do pretty much the same, I have tried everything to fix them, but there’s nothing I can do. I hope you can do something about it.

title: Worth a try but unfortunately missing skip and rewind functionality
body:
Finally decided to try this out and it’s much better than I expected! Great variety of workouts and really enthusiastic trainers. I just wish you could fast-forward/rewind workouts to skip parts, catch missed instructions or resume training if the app crashes.

Also, it would be great to see some more bodyweight only strength workouts and more coaches from countries other than the USA. Otherwise great app!

title: Using daily
body:
As I am a traveller, I really enjoy  the flexibility of being able to do a yoga/ dance/ HIIT workout wherever suits me either on my phone or through AppleTV. 
I find all of the trainers have different styles and favourite music genres which keeps things fresh and fun. 
I enjoy going for a walk and listening to the chats but would really like a “walk/run/ hike and listen to Apple music” functionality as well as “outdoor bike ride and listen to Apple music” ability while tracking my ride/ run/ walk etc…
I do not have a watch and have found my phone perfectly adequate. 
The awards are motivating for some but I’m really into the workouts & closing my rings.
